# proxmox_node_apt_update (Resource)

Runs `apt update` on one node through `POST /nodes/{node}/apt/update` and waits for the worker. The action is imperative: every change replaces the instance, destroy is a no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_apt_update" "daily" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node. Changes require replacement.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when to update again.

### Optional

- `notify` (Boolean) Send a notification with the result.
- `quiet` (Boolean) Suppress progress output. The Proxmox default is `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier (the node name).
- `upid` (String) Worker task UPID.
